title: Yogaverse
tagline: A global yoga community for the  real word and the metaverse!
description: An exclusive yoga community, membership site, and professional instructor certification network. The yoga environment is ripe for self-governance and peer-to-peer learning, but there’s one primary agency who rules over it all. It's time to disrupt the industry. In order to uphold yoga and meditation’s true value, teachers and students need a decentralized platform to connect with each other directly.
